content: A home office deduction generally requires part of the home to be used exclusively and regularly as a principal place of business or another qualifying business location.
Business expenses are generally deductible when they are ordinary and necessary expenses paid or incurred in carrying on a trade or business.
IRC Section 162 allows deductions for ordinary and necessary expenses paid or incurred during the taxable year in carrying on a trade or business.
Charitable contribution deductions require contributions to qualified organizations and may require records or written acknowledgment depending on the type and amount of the contribution.
Schedule C is used to report income or loss from a business operated as a sole proprietor and includes gross receipts, expenses, and profit or loss calculations.
